overall.verdict: This is a serious, conceptually excellent wallet: the dollar-per-pixel scale, the green-enforceable vs violet-promised split, per-frame receipts and the numbered dispute sheet are the strongest trust design I have reviewed in a self-custodial product, and the visual system is coherent enough to ship as a premium app. What keeps it from 850+ is execution detail, not ideas: 13px grey microcopy carries the load-bearing numbers, six-decimal precision appears on consumer decisions, several rows clip at the right edge, and the same quantity is formatted three different ways across screens.
priority_fixes: Legibility pass: every number that gates a decision ('send up to X', dispute window, 'may pull', legend chips) to ≥15px and ≥4.5:1, plus a Text size control in Settings — this alone moves Rosa, Priya and Ingrid

One numeric format rule: 2 decimals for USD, 6 significant digits for crypto, exact values behind a tap; kill 'up to 0.0000 WETH', '25.500023', '115.499973 → 197.449948' and unify fee display ('under 0.01 USDC' vs '0.000050 USDC')
Print the derivation for every capacity number: '150 spendable = 90 owed + 60 posted', '175 = 115 + 60', 'receive up to 250.75 = sum of 2 lanes' — on Home, Pay and the account screen

Fix the overflow/clip class: activity filter chips, Settings scale chips, the Sovereignty counterparty line, the 4-button receipt row and the Move TO-cards — add fades/snaps, wrap, or reduce to one primary plus a text-action row

Close the two unmet tasks: cross-network swap needs a visible 'lands in ~N s · total fee X' (Aisha), and the hub model needs a plain-language 'what a hub does and earns' panel reachable from the account screen (Omar), plus a one-tap 'secure this promise' from Sovereignty (Ingrid)

personas.name: Wei

personas.name: Elena

blockers: 08-activity-detail: 'Frames 2 committed entries' needs rewriting for a non-technical auditor

personas.name: Noah

personas.name: Aisha

blockers: 05b-swap-cross: no arrival time or total fee for the two-leg swap

personas.name: Lucas
personas.verdict: Receiving ten bucks was easy, but the moment I tried to turn it into ETH I hit 'bps', 'lot rounding', 'capacity via H1' and numbers with six decimals.
blockers: 05-swap: jargon ('1 bps', 'Lot rounding 0.000004 USDC stays with you') with no plain-language layer

personas.name: Ingrid

blockers: 15-sovereignty: the $90 promise has no one-tap mitigation path from the headline

personas.name: Omar

05-swap: 'H1 collateral tariff: 0.1 WETH base + 0 WETH gas + 1 bps' is the only revenue hint and it is buried in prose
